reviews.title: Easy and Clean PC Building!
reviews.comment: This case is easy to build with since all the panels are removable. The Icue link products are pricey, but they are well worth it. It cuts down on cables and centralizes all of your products under one controller by daisy chaining them together. All of the fans and ARGBs use a single cable type with the Icue Link. The new Corsair fans and Icue 360 Titan are nearly silent. I'm not a fan of the rubber edge covers for the wire management cutouts. It looks much cleaner without them. The cutouts are rounded off nicely so your cables and wires won't get chaffed or cut. This is the best case that I have ever used.
reviews.author: Rh3mY

reviews.title: Great Case for airflow AND aesthetics!
reviews.comment: Absolutely love my 3500X with the Icue link system! It's a beautiful case and I love the different options for fan sizes, I have a 140mm set for intake at the bottom front and every other slot filled with 120mm Icue link fans. The airflow in this case is top tier, I'm running a 5700X3D and a 9060XT with the Corsair Icue link titan 360 aio in this case, and even under full load on a 100 degree summer day I have never seen temps over 62 degrees C on cpu or GPU, I attribute that mostly to the airflow design of the case and the efficiency of the Icue link titan cooler. My only knock against this case is the big glass panel has gotten loose up at the top from the amount of times I have opened and closed it over the last year to clean or upgrade components. Other than that I have zero complaints, it's a beautiful case that's intuitive to build in, with cable management tie down points all over the place, several spots to put storage such a 2.5 inch and 3.5 inch Sata SSD or HDD. It's got plenty of room for even massive graphics cards and options for mounting the aio in the front or the top. It's worth noting that if you intend on doing a push pull configuration for the aio (fans mounted on both sides on the radiator) you'll want to side mount it rather than top mount because your ram will most likely gg in the way. I would absolutely recommend this case to anyone interested in building in a "fishbowl" case that's also looking for top tier airflow and cooling potential. There's plenty of room for even a custom water cooling loop, which will be my next adventure with this case

reviews.title: Clean Build, Great Cooling, and Efficient Setup
reviews.comment: We built two gaming rigs using this case—one for me and one for my son—with slightly different hardware but the same result: clean, efficient builds with excellent cooling, thanks to the Corsair iCUE Link system. The simple cable setup for the fans and the iCUE Link Titan 360 RX RGB Liquid CPU Cooler made cable management much easier compared to traditional setups. Each rig is running 10 fans, and the cooling has been quiet, efficient, and reliable, even during long gaming sessions. The iCUE software does take some time to learn—it’s not the most intuitive—but once you get used to it, it works well. I appreciate that it can control all Corsair iCUE Link fans and the cooler in one interface, with prebuilt or custom fan curve options. Overall, if you’re looking to build a clean, great-looking PC with efficient cooling, the Corsair 3500X iCUE Link case is a fantastic choice.
